summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli; every file under 400 lines, layered imports with no cycles, public API and __all__ unchanged, private names not re-exported, state and patch points moved to state.py and system.py). The unit tests pass and 379 CLI runs on samples and extra inputs match the original byte for byte; the only difference is that uncaught-exception tracebacks name tally.reports.errors.ReportError instead of tally.reports.ReportError, and `python -m tally.reports` no longer runs because the guide forbids a __main__.py.
